technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with bullish short-term indicators (AO cross-up, OBV rising) offset by overbought conditions (stoch, Williams %R) and weak intermediate trend structure; moderate confluence but elevated risk from bearish stochastic cross and price below 200-EMA.

fundamental.summary: LDOS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 69 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (395.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 69 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.
